assertion.rationale: F6: Initialize-FederatedCredential is invoked exactly twice in bootstrap, both times for the deployer — the mls-verifier identity that is supposed to run every layer's independent security-control assessment has no federated credential at all. Every azure/login with AZURE_VERIFIER_CLIENT_ID fails AADSTS70021, so the periodic control assessment CLAUDE.md describes as the core verification mechanism cannot execute. verify-g0.ps1's Test-VerifierApp only checks the app REGISTRATION exists, so G0 reports green over a verifier that cannot authenticate.

recommendation: Create the verifier's federated identity credential with a subject distinct from the deployer's. Extend Test-VerifierApp to assert both the credential's existence and its distinctness from the deployer, not just app-registration presence.
